editorialNote: These are dated options, not permanent rankings. Reorder, replace or revise entries in this data file after a source, policy, price or capability review.

video.name: Gemini Omni Flash
video.summary: Fast multimodal video generation and conversational editing with text, image, audio and video context.
video.costModel: Usage-based cloud API pricing; verify the current Gemini model pricing before approval.
video.licensingPrivacy: Review Google API terms, retention controls and commercial-use policy for every production. Do not send unreleased material without an approved data-handling basis.
video.recommendedUse: Rapid previs, shot exploration, continuity iterations and reference-led conversational edits.

video.name: Runway Video API and Model Router
video.summary: A production-oriented API with native and third-party video models plus cost, latency or quality routing.
video.costModel: Credit-based, generally priced per generated second and selected model; dry-run routing can estimate cost.
video.licensingPrivacy: Model-specific rights and provider retention rules vary. Confirm source-asset permissions and enterprise controls before uploading cast or location references.
video.recommendedUse: Controlled previs, model comparison and repeatable routing under a per-shot budget.

video.name: Luma Dream Machine API
video.summary: Image- and text-directed video generation with an asynchronous API and creative reference workflows.
video.costModel: Usage-based cloud generation; confirm the active model and current platform pricing.
video.licensingPrivacy: Review current Luma platform terms, input retention and output rights. Treat talent likeness and private reference footage as restricted assets.
video.recommendedUse: Atmosphere tests, motion studies and image-to-video storyboard animation.

image.name: GPT Image 2
image.summary: Current GPT Image generation and editing through single-shot or conversational APIs.
image.costModel: Usage-based pricing by output quality, size and API path; verify the live pricing page.
image.licensingPrivacy: Use approved API data controls, verify commercial and likeness rights, and keep credentials in the private server gateway.
image.recommendedUse: Character references, location concepts, storyboard keyframes and iterative visual continuity edits.

image.name: Nano Banana image models
image.summary: Google's recommended Gemini-native path for image generation after the Imagen deprecation.
image.costModel: Usage-based by selected Gemini image model and output; verify current pricing and quotas.
image.licensingPrivacy: Review Google API terms, model-specific safety rules, retention and commercial use before production material is uploaded.
image.recommendedUse: High-volume concept passes, multimodal reference synthesis and fast storyboard exploration.

image.name: FLUX.2 family
image.summary: Commercial cloud endpoints plus selected local-capable variants for teams that need deployment choice.
image.costModel: Per-image API credits; local variants add hardware and operations cost.
image.licensingPrivacy: Licences differ by variant: verify commercial eligibility. Local execution can reduce asset transfer but does not remove source and likeness obligations.
image.recommendedUse: Private visual-development experiments, batch concepts and local-capable image pipelines.

aggregator.name: Replicate
aggregator.summary: A broad model catalog with stable official-model APIs and predictable per-output pricing.
aggregator.costModel: Per output for official models; hardware-time or deployment pricing for other models.
aggregator.licensingPrivacy: Each model can carry different terms. Verify model licence, data handling and output rights before enabling it for a project.
aggregator.recommendedUse: Provider comparison, fallback models and experimental production pipelines behind one server-side adapter.

aggregator.name: fal
aggregator.summary: Queue-based access to a wide range of commercial image and video generation endpoints.
aggregator.costModel: Model-specific usage pricing, commonly per image, video or generated second.
aggregator.licensingPrivacy: Commercial labels do not replace a project-level rights review. Keep API keys server-side and verify retention for uploaded references.
aggregator.recommendedUse: Evaluate several image-to-video and reference-led systems without building a provider adapter for each one.

aggregator.name: OpenRouter multimodal APIs
aggregator.modelOrService: Image and video model discovery / generation
aggregator.summary: Model discovery and unified asynchronous media APIs with capability and pricing metadata.
aggregator.costModel: Provider/model-specific usage pricing exposed through model metadata.
aggregator.licensingPrivacy: Provider routing changes the data processor and applicable terms. Pin or constrain providers when confidentiality, residency or rights require it.
aggregator.recommendedUse: Capability-aware model selection, price comparison and replaceable media backends.
